description: Your client-portal dashboard exactly as the /portal page shows it, for the signed-in account only: key numbers (open requests, active orders, valid certificates, AI connections, unpaid orders…), recent activity, notifications and alerts, and an account overview. Each section can fail on its own (status "error"). Free text is wrapped as data.

locale.description: Language of notification titles. Default en.

sections.description: Sections to return. Default: all four.
